a diverse range of: The night market offers a diverse range of food, from stinky tofu and oyster omelets to Japanese sushi.
夜市提供各式各樣的食物，從臭豆腐、蚵仔煎到日本壽司都有。
culturally diverse: Taipei has become culturally diverse, with people from Vietnam, Japan, and Europe living and working in the city.
台北已變得多元文化，有來自越南、日本和歐洲的人在這座城市生活和工作。
a diverse workforce: The company is proud of its diverse workforce, which includes employees of different ages, countries, and backgrounds.
這家公司以其多元的員工團隊為傲，成員包括不同年齡、國籍和背景的員工。
divine intervention: Our team was losing by twenty points, so only divine intervention could help us win the final game.
我們隊落後二十分，所以只有神的介入才能幫我們贏得決賽。
divine right: In the past, many kings claimed they ruled by divine right, so questioning them meant questioning God.
過去許多國王宣稱自己依君權神授統治，所以質疑他們就等於質疑上帝。
divine inspiration: The poet said the idea for the poem came to her like divine inspiration, as if a voice from heaven had spoken.
詩人說這首詩的構想像神來的靈感般降臨，彷彿有來自天上的聲音對她說話。
a divine meal: My aunt cooked a divine meal for the Lunar New Year, and everyone said it was the most delicious food ever.
我阿姨為農曆新年煮了美味極了的一餐，大家都說那是有史以來最好吃的食物。
dizzy heights: After years of hard work, the young actor finally reached the dizzy heights of fame and success in Hollywood.
經過多年努力，這位年輕演員終於在好萊塢攀上名利的令人暈眩的高度。
feel dizzy: If you feel dizzy after running in the hot sun, sit down in the shade and drink some water.
如果你在大太陽下跑步後感到頭暈，就坐到陰涼處喝點水。
a dizzy pace: Technology is changing at a dizzy pace, and it is hard for older people to keep up with new phones.
科技正以令人頭暈目眩的速度改變，年長者很難跟上新手機。
documentary evidence: The police could not arrest him without documentary evidence, such as bank records or signed contracts.
沒有書面證據，例如銀行紀錄或簽署的合約，警方無法逮捕他。
a documentary film: We watched a documentary film about sea turtles that showed real footage of how plastic hurts them.
我們看了一部關於海龜的紀錄片，片中呈現塑膠如何傷害牠們的真實畫面。
a dominant position: The company holds a dominant position in the smartphone market, selling more phones than all its rivals together.
這家公司在智慧型手機市場佔有主導地位，賣出的手機比所有對手加起來還多。
the dominant culture: Immigrant children often learn the language of the dominant culture quickly but may forget their parents' language.
移民的孩子往往很快學會主流文化的語言，卻可能忘了父母的語言。
a dominant gene: In biology class we learned that brown eyes come from a dominant gene, which shows up even when only one parent passes it on.
在生物課上我們學到棕色眼睛來自顯性基因，即使只有父母一方遺傳也會表現出來。
a dominant personality: With her dominant personality, Mia always takes control of group projects and tells everyone what to do.
米亞性格強勢，總是掌控小組報告，並指揮每個人該做什麼。
be doubtful about: Many scientists are doubtful about the truth of the report, since no one else has been able to repeat the experiment.
許多科學家對這份報告的真實性有疑慮，因為沒有其他人能重現這項實驗。
It is doubtful whether…: It is doubtful whether the concert will go on tonight, because a typhoon is expected to hit the city this evening.
今晚的演唱會是否照常舉行令人懷疑，因為預計今晚颱風會侵襲這座城市。
a doubtful advantage: Living right next to the MRT station is a doubtful advantage, since the trains are convenient but noisy all night.
住在捷運站旁邊是未必有利的優勢，因為列車雖然方便，但整晚都很吵。
look doubtful: When I told my mom I had finished all my homework in ten minutes, she looked doubtful and asked to check it.
當我告訴媽媽我十分鐘就寫完所有作業時，她面露懷疑，要求檢查一下。
downtown Taipei: Our hotel is in downtown Taipei, so we can easily walk to department stores, restaurants, and the MRT station.
我們的飯店在台北市中心，所以可以輕鬆走路到百貨公司、餐廳和捷運站。
go downtown: On weekends we often go downtown to watch movies and shop, since our village has no cinema.
週末我們常進城看電影和購物，因為我們村子裡沒有電影院。
a dramatic change: Moving from a small village to New York brought a dramatic change to her life, from her diet to her daily schedule.
從小村莊搬到紐約為她的生活帶來急遽的變化，從飲食到日常作息都不同了。
a dramatic increase: There has been a dramatic increase in the number of tourists, which has doubled in just two years.
觀光客人數大幅增加，短短兩年內就成長了一倍。
a dramatic rescue: In a dramatic rescue, firefighters used a helicopter to pull the hikers off the cliff just before the storm arrived.
在一場驚險的救援中，消防員就在暴風雨來臨前用直升機把登山客從懸崖上救下來。
a dramatic effect: The new medicine had a dramatic effect; within a week, the patient could walk again without help.
這種新藥有顯著的效果；一週內病人就能不靠協助再次行走。
dramatic irony: In the play, the audience knows the letter is fake but the hero does not, which creates dramatic irony.
在這齣戲中，觀眾知道那封信是假的，主角卻不知道，這就形成了戲劇性反諷。
a dreadful mistake: I made a dreadful mistake by calling my teacher "Mom" in front of the whole class, and I still feel terrible about it.
我犯了一個嚴重的錯誤，在全班面前叫老師「媽媽」，到現在還覺得很糟。
dreadful weather: Because of the dreadful weather, with heavy rain and strong winds, our school trip to Kenting was canceled.
因為大雨強風、糟透的天氣，我們去墾丁的校外教學被取消了。
feel dreadful: I feel dreadful about forgetting my best friend's birthday, so I'm going to buy her a gift to say sorry.
忘了最好朋友的生日讓我感覺糟透了，所以我要買份禮物向她道歉。
